items.title: Energy Firms Try to Squeeze More Power Out of Old Nuclear Plants
items.author: Brad Plumer and Rebecca F. Elliott

items.title: Mixed Human Feelings After a Day at a Park Full of Robots
items.author: Yan Zhuang and Jiwoong Hong
items.content: <article>I went to Galaxy Robot Park in Seoul to see how we might one day live with robots. It was part cutting-edge technology, part theatrics.</article>
